proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no magic_item variant. There is no MagicItemRecord type, no magic item payload family, and no magic_item_root source atom wired into the surface. The entire encoding path is missing.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_speed effect on surface
proposed_widenings.justification: The boots double the wearer's Speed while active. The v4 atom modify_speed exists in the taxonomy but is not present in any surface type. A magic item effect surface type would need to include it, with a multiplier (×2) or additive-flat variant.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage scoped to enemy Opportunity Attacks against self
proposed_widenings.justification: The boots impose Disadvantage on attack rolls made by other creatures against the wearer, but only for Opportunity Attacks specifically. The existing RollKind union (attack_roll | saving_throw) has no sub-kind for Opportunity Attacks. The existing modify_roll_advantage in MasteryEffect modifies the target creature's rolls; here the attachment is reversed (self is the attachment, enemies are the rollers). Both the scoping and the directional attachment are missing surface shapes.
proposed_widenings.evidence: any creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against you has Disadvantage on the attack roll

proposed_widenings.name: duration_budget resource (timed use pool)
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's active power depletes from a shared 10-minute total across activations, not a discrete use count. This is a continuous-time budget that refills on Long Rest. UseCountResource (kind: use_count) models discrete counts; there is no surface shape for a per-unit-time depletion pool.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you've used the boots' property for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function for you until you finish a Long Rest.

proposed_widenings.name: toggle_deactivation activation cost
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is ended by a second heel-click (same gesture as activation). This is a deliberate toggle pattern — the active state is self-terminating via re-invocation. No existing ClassFeatureActivationCost or effect family models voluntary mid-duration deactivation via a re-trigger.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you click your heels together again, you end the effect.

proposed_widenings.name: attunement_slot resource on surface
proposed_widenings.justification: The item requires attunement. The v4 atom attunement_slot exists in the taxonomy (§7 Resource Atoms) but is not present in any surface type. A MagicItemRecord encoding path would need to surface attune + attunement_slot.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord has no magic_item variant, so no encoding is possible regardless of effect shape. Secondary gaps (modify_speed, OA-scoped disadvantage, duration_budget resource, toggle deactivation, attunement) would each require surface widening even after the structural gap is closed. The OA-scope gap is the most novel: it requires either a new RollKind variant ('opportunity_attack') or an attachment-filter mechanism to scope advantage/disadvantage modifiers to a specific attack sub-type made by others against the wearer.
